comments.body_html: Ok, so… for some reason, this case pops up at Skier instead of Jaeger, and appears to be available for… a single Ruble? That, and equipment icon doesn’t load (but it’s 3d model under ‘Inspect’ loads up fine).

comments.author: DeePix
comments.body_html:
Thanks for the report!

That was a leftover test config in the previous version. It has been fixed in v1.0.3.

The case is now sold by Jaeger for 250,000₽, with an alternative Jaeger barter trade. The icon loading was also cleaned up, so please update to v1.0.3 and overwrite the old files.

If the icon still doesn’t load after updating, let me know.

comments.author: ViP3R_76
comments.body_html: As a feature request, add an option to config to allow looting of melee weapons. If no other mod like SVM is used, this mod allows it. Else looting of melee´s is not possible ;)

comments.author: DeePix
comments.body_html:
Thanks for the suggestion!

I understand what you mean. Since the case is made for melee weapons, an optional config setting to allow melee weapon looting would make sense.

I’ll look into how SPT handles melee loot restrictions and see if I can add it as a disabled-by-default option, so it doesn’t affect players who only want the storage case.

comments.author: DeePix
comments.body_html:
Thanks again for the suggestion!

I added this in v1.0.4 as an optional config setting:

enableMeleeWeaponLooting: false

It is disabled by default. If enabled, the mod makes melee weapons lootable without touching SPT_Data.
